terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to AlmaMesh. By using AlmaMesh, you agree to these terms.
terms.s1_p1: By accessing or using AlmaMesh, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use AlmaMesh.
terms.s2_p1: AlmaMesh is a free, local-first Vedic astrology app that runs in your browser. The chart engine runs on your device (in WebAssembly); there is no account or chart-data backend. An optional feedback form uses a same-origin Cloudflare function and D1 database. AlmaMesh requires no login, password, or email sign-up — "profiles" are names saved locally. Your birth details and charts are never stored by the feedback service.

terms.s3_li2: We do NOT provide medical, legal, financial, or psychological guidance

terms.s3_p2: By using AlmaMesh, you acknowledge that astrology is a belief system, not a science, and that interpretations are generated by AI based on traditional astrological principles.

terms.s4_li2: There are no accounts, logins, passwords, or registration — nothing to sign up for and nothing for us to suspend or terminate.
terms.s4_li3: Profiles you create are local names stored only on this device; you control them and can delete them at any time.
terms.s4_li4: AlmaMesh is intended for users aged 13 and older.

terms.s6_p1: AI-generated interpretation, chat, and life-event organization are entirely optional and are never required to draw a chart.
terms.s6_li1: AI features work only if you choose to configure an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (for example, OpenRouter or your own).
terms.s6_li2: When you use them, PII-redacted chart prompts and chat questions are sent to the third-party endpoint you chose. privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: AlmaMesh ("we", "our", "us") keeps chart and profile data in your browser. There is no account or chart-data backend. An optional feedback form uses a same-origin Cloudflare function and D1 database as described below. This policy explains every runtime network path and what stays local.
privacy.s1_heading: 1. Your Data Stays on Your Device
privacy.s1_sub1_li1_text: Names you save for charts — stored only in this browser, never sent to us
privacy.s1_sub1_li2_text: Date, time, and place of birth, used on-device to compute your chart and stored only in this browser
privacy.s1_sub1_li3_text: Questions and interpretations are stored in this browser; when you use optional AI, the prompt is also sent to your chosen provider as described below
privacy.s1_sub2_li1_text: All durable product data, including portable settings and an optional AI key, is held in one SQLite database in your browser's private on-device storage (OPFS). Legacy localStorage and user-data IndexedDB values are migrated locally, verified, and then removed; they are not kept as mirrors. If a saved interpretation cannot be read, it is set aside on this device in a quarantine table inside that same SQLite database for up to 30 days instead of being lost. Older versions kept it in localStorage; it is moved into SQLite, verified, and that copy removed. It is never sent anywhere, is not included in backups, and is erased by Reset chart / start fresh, Reset & reload, or clearing site data. Deleting a profile removes the set-aside records that hold that profile's readings; a record that matches no profile stays until Reset chart / start fresh, Reset & reload, clearing site data, or the 30-day expiry removes it.
privacy.s1_sub2_li2_text: AlmaMesh stores no server copy of your chart, profile, birth details, life events, readings, or chat. Optional provider requests and feedback are the separately disclosed exceptions below.
privacy.s2_p1: AlmaMesh makes the network do only these things:
privacy.s2_li1: Delivery only: downloading the app and a signed, content-addressed astronomy bundle (the DE421 ephemeris and program files) so the engine can run offline afterward. This is a one-way download; it carries no personal data about you.
privacy.s2_li3: Birthplace search: when you look up a birthplace, the city name you type plus ordinary HTTPS/request metadata visible to the provider are sent to a maps geocoding service (Open-Meteo) to fetch its coordinates and timezone. Never your birth date, time, name, or chart. If you are offline, AlmaMesh falls back to a bundled city list and sends nothing.
privacy.s2_li2: Optional AI: if you enable interpretation or chat, PII-redacted chart facts and your chat question go to your chosen endpoint. If you submit life-event prose for organization after the disclosure, that narrative is sent as written without birth details or chart data.
privacy.s2_li4: Optional feedback: opening the form loads Cloudflare Turnstile when configured. Sending stores the page, thumbs sentiment, optional message as written, app version, and timestamp in our D1 feedback database. Do not include personal information.
privacy.s2_li5: Operate accounts, logins, or collect your email — there is nothing to sign up for
privacy.s2_li6: Collect, store, or process your birth details or charts on our servers
privacy.s2_li7: Sell your data, track you across sites, or run targeted advertising
privacy.s3_li1: AI interpretation and chat are optional and are never required to draw a chart. They work only if YOU configure an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (for example, OpenRouter or your own).
privacy.s3_li2: Chart-derived AI prompts are PII-redacted and fail-closed before they reach the endpoint YOU chose. A life-event narrative is sent as written only after its separate disclosure. Those requests are subject to that provider's privacy policy and terms, not ours.
privacy.s3_li3: If you never configure an endpoint, no prompt ever leaves your device. The chart engine itself is zero-egress.
privacy.s4_p1: AlmaMesh uses no advertising or analytics trackers. Cloudflare Turnstile loads only when you open the optional feedback form and may process normal anti-bot request metadata. Product data otherwise stays in the browser storage described above.
privacy.s5_p1: Because your birth date, time, and chart never leave your device, you are always in direct control of your data:
privacy.s5_li1_text: Chart, profile, chat, and life-event data are visible in this browser. A feedback submission is a separate server record and may include whatever you typed in its optional message.
privacy.s5_li2_text: Remove a profile or chart in Settings, or clear your browser's site data / uninstall the app. See the Data Deletion page.
privacy.s5_li3_text: Export one password-encrypted .almamesh file and import it in another browser or device, such as Chrome to iOS Safari. The password protects the transfer file only and is entered once on import.
privacy.s6_li1: Chart, profile, chat, and life-event data stay on your device until you delete them. Optional feedback submissions are retained separately in D1 for product improvement.
privacy.s6_li2: Deleting browser data is immediate but does not delete feedback already submitted. Because feedback has no account identifier, avoid personal information and contact us with the message details if you need help locating a submission.
privacy.s7_p1: AlmaMesh is not intended for users under 13 years of age.
privacy.s8_p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will post the new policy on this page with an updated effective date.

data_deletion.title: Data Deletion Instructions
data_deletion.intro: Your charts, profiles, life events, readings, and chat live only in this browser, so deleting them means removing them here. Optional feedback you previously submitted is a separate anonymous server record; see What We Retain below.
data_deletion.opt1_heading: Option 1: Delete a Profile or Chart In-App (Recommended)
data_deletion.opt1_li4_prefix: Select the profile or chat and choose
data_deletion.opt1_p1: The selected profile, its chart, and its chat history are removed from this browser immediately.
data_deletion.opt2_heading: Option 2: Clear All Data at Once
data_deletion.opt2_p1: To remove everything, clear AlmaMesh's site data in your browser or uninstall the app:
data_deletion.opt2_p2: Either of these wipes all AlmaMesh data on this device:
data_deletion.opt2_li1: Clear site data / cookies and storage for AlmaMesh in your browser settings
data_deletion.opt2_li2: Uninstall the AlmaMesh app (PWA) from your device
data_deletion.opt2_p3: This is instant and final for browser data. It does not remove optional feedback already submitted.
data_deletion.deleted_p1: Deleting in-app or clearing site data removes from this browser:
data_deletion.deleted_li2: Your birth chart data and interpretations
data_deletion.deleted_li4: Your saved preferences (including any AI endpoint you configured)
data_deletion.deleted_li5: The cached astronomy bundle and app files
data_deletion.deleted_quarantine: Interpretations set aside as unreadable (the quarantine table in the on-device SQLite database) are removed when you delete the profile they belong to. A record too damaged to match to any profile is erased by Reset & reload, Settings → Preferences → Reset chart / start fresh, or clearing site data; otherwise it is deleted automatically after 30 days.
data_deletion.retention_li1: We retain only optional feedback submissions in D1: timestamp, page, thumbs sentiment, optional message as written, and app version. Feedback has no AlmaMesh account identifier.
data_deletion.retention_li2: We retain no server copy of your charts, profiles, birth details, readings, life events, chat, or AI settings. Contact us with the feedback message details if you need help locating a submission.
